title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: Deleting a comment block is seen again
summary: Select a comment block near the bottom of a file and delete it, and the forced unwrap highlight and the color swatches below stayed painted inside text that had just become documentation.

highlights.title: A Deleted Block Near The End
highlights.description: Deleting three lines or more that carry the end of a comment block or of a raw string now rebuilds the decorations, even when the shortened document falls below the end of what was deleted.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: The rebuild trigger reads the memory of what each deleted line held over the whole range, not only over the part the shortened document still reaches.
Both the color swatches and the forced unwrap highlight carried the same bound, and both are fixed.
